methodology: All four models are evaluated on the identical held-out test set (pooled test_temporal.pt across all clients, never used in any model's training). Centralized models train on all clients' data pooled together (no privacy). Federated models never pool raw data. Federated training budget: 10 rounds x 3 clients/round x 2 local epochs. Centralized deep model: 5 epochs over the full pooled training set (not identical compute budget - see train_seconds per model).

centralized_rf.name: Centralized RandomForest
centralized_rf.description: Classical ML baseline. All clients' raw data pooled into one place, one model.

centralized_deep.name: Centralized Deep Model
centralized_deep.description: Same Temporal Graph Transformer architecture, but all clients' raw data pooled - isolates the cost of federation alone (no DP either).

federated_fedavg.name: Federated (FedAvg, no DP)
federated_fedavg.description: Same architecture, data never leaves clients, but no differential privacy - isolates the cost of DP alone (federation is already applied).

federated_fedprox_dp.name: Federated (FedProx + DP) — this project
federated_fedprox_dp.description: Data never leaves clients (FedProx handles non-IID drift) AND each round's aggregate is clipped + noised (client-level DP-FedAvg, epsilon=100.0).
